name: Single Scattering Estimation for Self-Shadowing
definition: Estimates the mean amount of single scattering energy leaving a voxel block to correct the self-shadowing probability, which is incorrect after the initial transparency matching step.
summary: Single Scattering Estimation for Self-Shadowing is a refinement step that corrects self-shadowing probability in low-resolution voxels by scaling density and albedo to match the mean single scattering energy of the original high-resolution input.
